label: risk management system
definition: A continuous iterative process planned and run throughout the entire lifecycle of a high-risk AI system, requiring regular systematic review and updating.
source_quote: The risk management system shall be understood as a continuous iterative process planned and run throughout the entire lifecycle of a high-risk AI system, requiring regular systematic review and updating.

label: identification and analysis of risks
definition: The identification and analysis of known and reasonably foreseeable risks that the high-risk AI system can pose to health, safety or fundamental rights when used in accordance with its intended purpose.
source_quote: the identification and analysis of the known and the reasonably foreseeable risks that the high-risk AI system can pose to health, safety or fundamental rights when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose

label: estimation and evaluation of risks
definition: The estimation and evaluation of risks that may emerge when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose, and under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse.
source_quote: the estimation and evaluation of the risks that may emerge when the high-risk AI system is used in accordance with its intended purpose, and under conditions of reasonably foreseeable misuse

label: evaluation of other risks based on post-market monitoring
definition: The evaluation of other risks possibly arising, based on the analysis of data gathered from the post-market monitoring system.
source_quote: the evaluation of other risks possibly arising, based on the analysis of data gathered from the post-market monitoring system referred to in Article 72

label: risk management measures
definition: Appropriate and targeted measures designed to address the risks identified, giving due consideration to combined application of requirements and minimizing risks effectively.
source_quote: the adoption of appropriate and targeted risk management measures designed to address the risks identified pursuant to point (a)

label: elimination or reduction of risks
definition: Elimination or reduction of risks identified and evaluated in as far as technically feasible through adequate design and development of the high-risk AI system.
source_quote: elimination or reduction of risks identified and evaluated pursuant to paragraph 2 in as far as technically feasible through adequate design and development of the high-risk AI system

label: mitigation and control measures
definition: Implementation of adequate mitigation and control measures addressing risks that cannot be eliminated.
source_quote: where appropriate, implementation of adequate mitigation and control measures addressing risks that cannot be eliminated

label: provision of information and training
definition: Provision of information required pursuant to Article 13 and, where appropriate, training to deployers.
source_quote: provision of information required pursuant to Article 13 and, where appropriate, training to deployers

label: testing for risk management measures
definition: Testing high-risk AI systems to identify the most appropriate and targeted risk management measures, ensuring consistent performance and compliance.
source_quote: High-risk AI systems shall be tested for the purpose of identifying the most appropriate and targeted risk management measures. Testing shall ensure that high-risk AI systems perform consistently for their intended purpose and that they are in compliance with the requirements set out in this Section.

label: testing in real-world conditions
definition: Testing procedures may include testing in real-world conditions in accordance with Article 60.
source_quote: Testing procedures may include testing in real-world conditions in accordance with Article 60.

label: testing prior to placement on market
definition: Testing of high-risk AI systems shall be performed at any time throughout the development process, and in any event, prior to their being placed on the market or put into service.
source_quote: The testing of high-risk AI systems shall be performed, as appropriate, at any time throughout the development process, and, in any event, prior to their being placed on the market or put into service.

label: testing against defined metrics
definition: Testing shall be carried out against prior defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds that are appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.
source_quote: Testing shall be carried out against prior defined metrics and probabilistic thresholds that are appropriate to the intended purpose of the high-risk AI system.

label: consideration of adverse impact on vulnerable groups
definition: Providers shall give consideration to whether the high-risk AI system is likely to have an adverse impact on persons under the age of 18 and, as appropriate, other vulnerable groups.
source_quote: providers shall give consideration to whether in view of its intended purpose the high-risk AI system is likely to have an adverse impact on persons under the age of 18 and, as appropriate, other vulnerable groups

label: integration with internal risk management processes
definition: Aspects provided in paragraphs 1 to 9 may be part of, or combined with, the risk management procedures established pursuant to other relevant provisions of Union law.
source_quote: the aspects provided in paragraphs 1 to 9 may be part of, or combined with, the risk management procedures established pursuant to that law
